on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - run: ruff check .

      - run: pytest -q

  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5

          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"

    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
